summary: dellemc.openmanage 11.8.0 adds iDRAC10 support to idrac_bios, idrac_diagnostics, idrac_firmware, the idrac_job_queue role, idrac_lifecycle_controller_logs, idrac_network_attributes, idrac_secure_boot, the idrac_server_powerstate role, idrac_session, idrac_system_erase, redfish_event_subscription and redfish_power_state.
questions: Can I manage power state on iDRAC10 with Ansible?
Which openmanage modules got iDRAC10 support in 11.8.0?

answer_card.title: iDRAC10 support added in 11.8.0
answer_card.answer_md: iDRAC10 support was added to: `idrac_bios`, `idrac_diagnostics`, `idrac_firmware`, `idrac_job_queue` (role), `idrac_lifecycle_controller_logs`, `idrac_network_attributes`, `idrac_secure_boot`, `idrac_server_powerstate` (role), `idrac_session`, `idrac_system_erase`, `redfish_event_subscription` and `redfish_power_state`.
